title: Project Stewardship System — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of Project Stewardship System's rich face: what was made for each section, and the fingerprint of the words each piece was made against, so the page can say when a piece may lag the text. I grow when the entry is enriched again; I never hold the entry's words.
note: A light face, from the light round of 2026-11, third batch: one small thing beside one sentence, not a walk up to a test. Made by the working session (a child) in Enrichment/light-round-2026-11/, where the makers and data stay; placed here by the Concierge. A challenger has now read this piece (2026-11-11); its verdict is in the section's challenge block. It was made before the challenge of the first forty came back (16 keep, 24 remake), so it likely carries the same kinds of fault that challenge found: a caption that reads more into the page than the page says, a 'what is real' line that owns too little, a count off by one where a parser was naive. Every section is a proposal until Loudon approves it.

pieces.title: Waiting on an ear
pieces.caption: One square for each of the 121 notes the stewards left saying a thing is still rough. Eighty-seven carry an ear: nobody has listened yet. Nineteen say nobody has opened it. *What is real and what is a choice:* The page's own numbers, from the fleet reading of 2026-10-16, so a month old. *Leaking in:* Pauline Oliveros: the ear is her avatar.

verdicts.why: The numbers are the page's and they check against the record; the wall of ears makes "short of Loudon's senses" visible at a glance, and the ear is a small step past a plain unit chart. Notes, none needing a redraw of the idea. The sheet says "nobody has listened to it yet" in the present tense, while the same sentence on the page goes on to say seven of those were then put in front of Loudon; say "said, on 2026-10-16".
